channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan hakin ballanqaadyadeeda NPT, iyadoo kooxaha adag ay ka hadlayaan bam nukliyeer
item.description: Iran ayaa sheegtay inaysan hakin waajibaadkeeda heshiiska ka-hortagga faafidda hubka nukliyeerka (NPT), hase yeeshee kormeerro caalami ah oo ballaaran oo lagu sameeyo goobaheeda ayaa weli fog, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Maxkamad rafcaan oo ku taal London oo baabi'isay sharcigii Trinidad iyo Tobago ee mamnuucayay galmada khaniisiinta
item.description: Maxkamadda rafcaanka ugu dambaysa ee Trinidad iyo Tobago, oo fadhigeedu yahay England, ayaa Talaadadii baabi'isay sharci qarniyo jiray oo dambi ka dhigayay galmada dadka isku jinsiga ah, sida ay werisay ABC News.

item.title: Scott McTominay oo shaaciyay inuu daaweyn wadnaha ah helay intii lagu jiray Koobka Adduunka
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Napoli iyo xulka Scotland, Scott McTominay, ayaa sheegay inuu daaweyn lagu saxayo garaaca wadnaha oo aan caadi ahayn helay laba maalmood ka hor guushii Scotland ee Haiti bishii June ee Koobka Adduunka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Xisbiga National Rally oo heshiis hordhac ah la gaaray bangiyo si loo maalgeliyo ololaha Le Pen
item.description: Xisbiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, National Rally, ayaa heshiis hordhac ah la gaaray laba bangi oo Yurub ah oo ku saabsan amaah dhan 10.6 milyan euro oo lagu maalgelinayo ololaha doorashada madaxtinimo ee Marine Le Pen, sida uu sheegay khasnajiga xisbiga.

item.title: Masar oo sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay bilooyin joogeen Sacuudi Carabiya ujeeddo difaac
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa sheegay in askar Masaari ah ay bilooyin badan joogeen Sacuudi Carabiya si ay u ilaaliyaan goobo muhiim ah kadib weerarro lagu qaaday boqortooyada, isagoo xusay in ciidamadaasi aysan u gudbi doonin Yemen.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo xaqiijisay kiis dhimasho ah oo qandhada jaallaha ah ee degmada Morobo
item.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xaqiijisay in nin beeralay ah oo 48 jir ah oo ku noolaa degmada Morobo ee gobolka Central Equatoria uu u dhintay qandhada jaallaha (yellow fever), kadib safar uu ku tagay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo, sida uu werisay Radio Tamazuj.

item.title: Pochettino oo la sheegay inuu xiiseynayo inuu ka tago xulka Mareykanka oo uu u dhaqaaqo Manchester United
item.description: Tababaraha xulka ragga Mareykanka, Mauricio Pochettino, ayaa xiiseynaya inuu qaato shaqada tababarenimo ee Manchester United, xiisahaasna waa mid labada dhinac ah, sida ay wargeyska The Guardian u sheegeen ilo badan.

item.title: Baarlamaanka Uganda oo amray baaritaan laba toddobaad ah oo ku saabsan maalgashiga Dei BioPharma
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Uganda, Jacob Oboth, ayaa faray guddiga sayniska iyo tiknoolajiyadda inuu laba toddobaad gudahood baaro maalgashiga 723.4 bilyan oo shilin ee dowladdu ku samaysay shirkadda Dei BioPharma, sida uu werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Kenya oo safaaradeedii Haiti u wareejisay magaalada Mexico City
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Kenya ayaa sheegtay in xafiiska diblomaasiyadeed ee Port-au-Prince loo raray Mexico City, taas oo qayb ka ah dib-u-habeyn lagu sameynayo safaaradaha dalka, sida uu werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Eli Junior Kroupi oo markii ugu horreysay loogu yeeray xulka Faransiiska, isagoo beddelaya Marcus Thuram
item.description: Weeraryahanka Bournemouth ee 20 jirka ah, Eli Junior Kroupi, ayaa tababaraha xulka Faransiiska Zinédine Zidane markii ugu horreysay u yeeray, si uu u beddelo Marcus Thuram oo dhaawac uga baxay xerada, sida ay werisay RMC Sport.

item.title: Jeneraal Muhoozi oo xiray bartiisa X kadib hanjabaad uu u diray Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Uganda
item.description: Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, Jeneraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa xiray bartiisa X kadib qoraallo uu ugu hanjabay Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Jessica Alupo inay xilka ka dhaqaaqdo, sida uu werisay wargeyska The Citizen.

item.title: Formula 1 oo xilli ciyaareedka ku soo gabagabeyn doonta Qatar iyo Abu Dhabi sidii loo qorsheeyay
item.description: Formula 1 ayaa ku wargelisay garoonka Imola ee Talyaaniga in aan loo baahan doonin kayd ahaan, iyadoo tartannada Qatar (27 ilaa 29 November) iyo Abu Dhabi (4 ilaa 6 December) ay dhici doonaan sidii loo qorsheeyay inkasta oo ay socoto colaadda Mareykanka iyo Israa'iil ay la leeyihiin Iran, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Booliiska Faransiiska oo dad u xiray baaritaanka Mohamed Al Fayed
item.description: Booliiska Faransiiska ayaa dad xiray kadib markii ay baareen saddex hanti oo uu ku jiro hotelka Ritz ee Paris, iyagoo ka shaqeynaya baaritaanka xadgudubyadii loo aaneeyay Mohamed Al Fayed, sida ay sheegtay warqad Booliiska Magaalada London (Met) u direen dhibbanayaasha, oo ay werisay BBC.

item.title: TAZARA oo joojisay tareenada u dhexeeya Mbeya iyo Makambako ilaa 1 December
item.description: Hay'adda Tareenada Tanzania iyo Zambia (TAZARA) ayaa joojisay adeegyada tareenada rakaabka iyo xamuulka ee u dhexeeya Mbeya iyo Makambako ilaa 1 December 2026, kadib shil tareen xamuul oo burburiyay dhowr kiilomitir oo jidka tareenka ah, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.

item.title: Uganda oo sheegtay inay hakadka ka qaadi doonto qaar ka mid ah hay'adaha NGO-yada
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Uganda, Ephraim Kamuntu, ayaa sheegay in hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn ee la hubiyo inay xalliyeen walaacyadii laga qabay loo oggolaan doono inay dib u bilaabaan hawlahooda, kadib dib-u-eegis lagu sameeyay 10 hay'adood oo la hakiyay, sida uu werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Qiimaha alaabta Mareykanka oo October kordhay 0.4 boqolkiiba, in ka badan intii la filayay
item.description: Qiimaha alaabta macaamiisha ee Mareykanka ayaa bishii October kordhay 0.4 boqolkiiba marka loo eego bishii ka horreysay, halka dhaqaaleyahannadu filayeen 0.3 boqolkiiba, sida ay muujisay xog uu Talaadadii soo saaray Xafiiska Tirakoobka Shaqada (BLS).

item.title: Hegseth oo isku dayga xil ka qaadistiisa ku tilmaamay jees-jees iyo carqaladeyn
item.description: Wasiirka Difaaca Mareykanka, Pete Hegseth, ayaa Talaadadii shir jaraa'id ku sheegay in qaraarka xil ka qaadistiisa ee Golaha Wakiillada uu yahay jees-jees iyo ciyaar siyaasadeed, isagoo dhaliisha loo jeediyay iyo dagaalka Iran ku tilmaamay khilaaf siyaasadeed, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Usman Khawaja oo sheegay in xubin MCC ah ay cunsuriyad ula dhaqantay Lord's sannadkii 2023
item.description: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee kubadda cricket-ka Australia, Usman Khawaja, ayaa buuggiisa cusub ee taariikh nololeedka ku sheegay in xubin ka tirsan naadiga Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) ay si cunsuriyad ah u caayday intii lagu jiray ciyaartii Ashes ee Lord's sannadkii 2023, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Anthropic oo qorsheyneysa inay ilaa $64 bilyan ka ururiso suuqa saamiyada Nasdaq
item.description: Shirkadda sirdoonka macmalka ah ee Anthropic, oo samaysay barnaamijka Claude, ayaa sheegtay inay saamiyadeeda ku iibin doonto inta u dhexeysa $70 iyo $78 halkii saami marka ay ku biirto suuqa saamiyada Nasdaq ee New York, iyadoo ku ururin karta ilaa $64 bilyan, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Baarlamaanka cusub ee Israa'iil oo la dhaariyay, Eisenkot oo isku dayaya dhisidda dowlad
item.description: Xildhibaannada cusub ee Knesset-ka Israa'iil ayaa Talaadadii la dhaariyay, iyadoo hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Gadi Eisenkot uu isku dayayo inuu dhiso dowlad xukunka kaga tuurta ra'iisul wasaare ku-simaha Benjamin Netanyahu, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Wasiir Daahir Shire oo Beledweyne ka sheegay in dowladdu dareensan tahay tabashada reer Hiiraan
item.description: Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed, oo hoggaaminaya wafdi maanta gaaray Beledweyne, ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalku dareensan tahay tabashada dadka gobolka Hiiraan oo ay ka qayb qaadan doonto xalkeeda, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo soo dhoweysay 171 muwaadin oo laga soo celiyay Liibiya
item.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta soo dhoweysay 171 muwaadin oo dalka dib loogu soo celiyay kadib markii ay horey ugu tahriibeen Liibiya, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Safiirka Turkiga iyo La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga milatari iyo amniga
item.description: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka, Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf Axmed, waxayna ka wada hadleen iskaashiga milatari iyo amni ee labada dal iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada, sida ay sheegtay safaaradda Turkiga.

item.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran: Laba markab oo saliid qaada ayaa dab ku qabsaday Marinka Hormuz
item.description: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay in Talaadadii laba markab oo saliid qaada ay dab ku qabsaday Marinka Hormuz, kaddib qarax ka dhacay waddo aysan Iran oggolaan.

item.title: Qiimaha saliidda Brent oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo August ka hooseeyay 90 doolar
item.description: Saliidda Brent ayaa Talaadadii hoos ugu dhacday in ka yar 90 doolar fuustii, markii ugu horreysay tan iyo August, kaddib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu tilmaamay in dagaalka Iran uu dhammaan karo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Maxkamad Malaysia oo u oggolaatay in Najib Razak loo wareejiyo xabsi guri
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Kuala Lumpur ayaa go'aamisay in ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Malaysia Najib Razak, oo 73 jir ah, uu inta ka hartay xukunkiisa la dhimay ee 6 sano ah ku qaato xabsi guri, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: RC Lens oo xilka ka qaadday tababare Yannick Cahuzac 2 bilood kaddib magacaabistiisa
item.description: Kooxda Lens ee horyaalka Faransiiska ayaa Talaadadii xilka ka qaadday tababaraheeda Yannick Cahuzac, kaddib toddobaad ay 3 jeer isku xigta ku guuldarreysatay, sida ay wariyeen L'Équipe iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Japan oo Filibiin siinaysa radar xeebeed iyo diyaarado drone ah oo qiimahoodu yahay 4.3 bilyan yen
item.description: Japan iyo Filibiin ayaa Manila ku saxiixay heshiis deeq ah oo 4.3 bilyan yen (24 milyan euro) ah, kaas oo Japan ay ku siinayso ciidamada Filibiin nidaam radar xeebeed ah iyo diyaarado drone ah oo lagu kormeero maraakiibta, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Bulgaria: Ugu yaraan 11 qof oo ku dhintay shil baabuur badan oo meel u dhow Yambol
item.description: Ugu yaraan 11 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 48 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen shil ay ku lug lahaayeen baabuur badan oo ka dhacay waddada weyn ee Trakia meel u dhow magaalada Yambol ee Bulgaria, sida uu sheegay Ra'iisul Wasaare Rumen Radev.

item.title: Uganda oo bilaabaysa barnaamij qaran oo tababar degdeg ah oo lagu daryeelayo dadka dhaawacma
item.description: Barnaamij qaran oo shaqaalaha caafimaadka, shaqaalaha ambalaasta iyo shacabka caadiga ah lagu barayo sida loo gurmado dadka dhaawacma ayaa laga bilaabayaa Uganda, si loo yareeyo dhimashada laga hortagi karo, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
